name: Mathias Lechner

affiliations.org: Institute of Science and Technology Austria (ISTA)

bio: Mathias Lechner is co-founder and chief technology officer of Liquid AI and a research affiliate at MIT CSAIL. Lechner completed a PhD at the Institute of Science and Technology Austria in 2022 and co-authored the Nature Machine Intelligence paper on neural circuit policies and the work on liquid time-constant networks.
known_for: Co-founder and CTO of Liquid AI
Neural circuit policies for auditable autonomy
